nodes.description: Address array index of all Artwork contracts spawned by this factory.
Hard-coded Registrar contract address used as the Ethart network interface.
Returns the number of artworks created (artworks.length).
Deploys a new Artwork contract after checking the SHA256 hash and factory approval via the Registrar.
Current owner of the artwork contract; receives owner commission.
SHA256 hash identifying the artwork.
Total number of pieces in the edition; mutated by burn/burnFrom.
Title of the artwork.
Link to the artwork file.
Proof link set by the artist after deployment.
Free-form custom text attached to the artwork.
Owner commission in basis points used in sale/bid payout arithmetic.
Current lowest ask price for a piece.
Seller of the lowest ask; receives sale proceeds.
Timestamp when the current ask was placed (24h cancel lock).
Flag indicating a piece is currently offered for sale.
Current highest bid price.
Address of the highest bidder; refunded on cancel/outbid.
Timestamp when the current bid was placed (24h cancel lock).
Deployment timestamp used for the one-year Ethart lock.
Flag indicating an outstanding bid exists.
Whether the artist proof has already been set (one-shot guard).
Number of pieces awarded to the Registrar (Ethart) when proof is set.
Mapping of address to number of pieces owned (ERC20 balances).
ERC20 allowance mapping used by transferFrom and burnFrom.
Hard-coded Registrar contract address; receives 2.5% of every sale.
Constructor: validates commission and initialises all artwork parameters, owner and activationTime.
Transfers ownership of the artwork contract; guarded by onlyBy(owner).
Sets the artist proof and awards pieces to Ethart using editionSize/40 plus timestamp-modulo randomness.
ERC20 transfer of pieces, guarded by notLocked modifier.
Returns editionSize as the ERC20 total supply.
Returns the number of pieces owned by an address.
ERC20 transferFrom using the allowed mapping, guarded by notLocked.
Sets ERC20 allowance for a spender.
Returns the remaining ERC20 allowance.
Burns own pieces and decreases editionSize with an unchecked subtraction.
Burns pieces of another address using allowance; decreases editionSize unchecked.
Payable purchase of the piece on sale: splits msg.value into owner/seller/registrar payouts and issues Patron tokens.
Offers a piece for sale at a price lower than current lowest ask; may immediately fill an existing bid.
Places a payable bid; refunds the previous highest bidder and may trigger buyPiece.
Accepts the highest bid: splits funds between owner, seller and registrar and issues Patron tokens.
Cancels the caller's bid after 24 hours and refunds the highest bid price.
Cancels the caller's sale after 24 hours and resets ask state.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balances, payouts and authentication.
now: used for activationTime, 24h/1-year locks and proof award randomness.
buyPiece sends ETH to owner, lowestAskAddress and registrar before clearing pieceForSale/lowestAskPrice.
fillBid sends ETH to owner, msg.sender and registrar before decrementing piecesOwned and clearing pieceWanted.
buyPiece executes piecesOwned[lowestAskAddress]-- without verifying a balance greater than zero.
burn/burnFrom do editionSize -= _amount without a lower bound check, risking underflow.
Payout split uses msg.value / 10000 * ownerCommission and / 40 divisions causing precision loss and rounding.
placeBid refunds highestBidAddress.transfer(highestBidPrice) before overwriting the bid state.
cancelBid performs msg.sender.transfer(highestBidPrice) before clearing bid state.
newArtwork makes external calls into the registrar Interface (isSHA256HashRegistered, isFactoryApproved, registerArtwork).
buyPiece/fillBid call registrar.issuePatrons(to, amount) as an external call after ETH transfers.
setProof computes ethartAward = (editionSize - remainder)/40 and piecesOwned[owner] = editionSize - ethartAward.
setProof uses now % 39 to probabilistically award an extra piece (miner-controllable timestamp randomness).
Hash parameter passed by caller and registered with the Registrar.
Edition size parameter forwarded to the new Artwork contract.
Owner commission parameter forwarded to the new Artwork contract.
New owner address accepted with no validation.
Proof link string stored in proofLink.
Transfer recipient.
Number of pieces transferred.
Source address for transferFrom.
Destination address for transferFrom.
Number of pieces moved by transferFrom.
Address granted an allowance.
Allowance amount.
Number of pieces to burn; subtracted from editionSize.
Address whose pieces are burned.
Number of pieces burned on behalf of _from.
Ask price supplied by the seller.
Interface instance of the registrar used for external calls.
Newly created Artwork contract instance.
Remainder of editionSize % 40 used in the Ethart award arithmetic.
Owner commission portion computed from msg.value.
Ethart (registrar) 2.5% portion of msg.value.
Seller payout = msg.value - owner - ethart.
Owner commission portion of highestBidPrice.
Ethart (registrar) portion of highestBidPrice.
Seller payout = highestBidPrice - owner - ethart.
Patron token reward = highestBidPrice / 5 * 2 passed to issuePatrons.

edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the _owner argument of the new Artwork constructor.
newArtwork reads Factory.registrar to instantiate the Interface.
newArtwork pushes the created Artwork address into the artworks array.
newArtwork relies on external registrar interface calls for hash uniqueness and factory approval.
getContractCount returns artworks.length.
Parameter _SHA256ofArtwork flows into newArtwork and registration.
Parameter _editionSize flows into the new Artwork deployment.
Parameter _ownerCommission flows into the new Artwork deployment.
Local Interface a is used for all registrar external calls in newArtwork.
Local Artwork c is the created contract returned and pushed.
Constructor sets owner directly from the factory-supplied _owner with no authorisation check.
Constructor compares _ownerCommission against 9750 and 0 (validation is ineffective for unsigned values).
Constructor sets activationTime = now.
block.timestamp (now) is read in the constructor.
Constructor initialises editionSize.
onlyBy(owner) modifier compares msg.sender against the owner.
changeOwner overwrites the owner state variable.
newOwner parameter becomes the new privileged owner without validation.
setProof is restricted by the onlyBy(owner) modifier.
Proof award decision depends on block.timestamp (now % 39).
setProof computes ethartAward and piecesOwned[owner] = editionSize - ethartAward.
setProof uses now % 39 as probabilistic randomness for the extra Ethart piece.
setProof writes piecesOwned for the registrar and the owner.
setProof sets the proofSet guard flag.
setProof writes ethartAward.
setProof writes proofLink.
_proofLink parameter is stored in proofLink.
Local remainder feeds the Ethart award arithmetic.
transfer uses msg.sender as the source of the pieces.
transfer updates piecesOwned balances for sender and recipient.
notLocked modifier reads lowestAskAddress to prevent moving a piece on sale.
_to parameter is the transfer recipient.
_amount parameter is the transferred quantity.
transferFrom checks allowed[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom updates piecesOwned balances.
transferFrom decreases the allowed mapping.
_from parameter is the source of transferFrom.
_to parameter is the destination of transferFrom.
_amount parameter is the quantity moved.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
approve updates the allowance mapping.
_spender parameter receives the allowance.
_amount parameter is the allowance value.
burn uses msg.sender as the account whose pieces are destroyed.
burn decrements editionSize without a lower bound check.
burn decreases piecesOwned[msg.sender].
burn mutates editionSize via unchecked subtraction.
_amount parameter is subtracted from balances and editionSize.
burnFrom checks allowed[_from][msg.sender].
burnFrom decrements editionSize without a lower bound check.
burnFrom decreases piecesOwned[_from].
burnFrom decreases the allowance mapping.
_from parameter is the account burned from.
_value is subtracted from piecesOwned and editionSize.
buyPiece increments piecesOwned[msg.sender] and issues patrons to msg.sender.
buyPiece checks and then clears pieceForSale.
buyPiece reads and resets lowestAskPrice.
buyPiece reads and clears lowestAskAddress.
buyPiece sends ETH to owner, seller and registrar before resetting pieceForSale/lowestAskPrice state.
An ETH recipient (owner or lowestAskAddress) could re-enter buyPiece while pieceForSale is still true.
buyPiece executes piecesOwned[lowestAskAddress]-- without checking the balance, allowing underflow.
buyPiece computes owner commission as msg.value / 10000 * ownerCommission causing rounding loss.
buyPiece makes an external issuePatrons call on the registrar after ETH transfers.
registrar.issuePatrons is an external call that could re-enter buyPiece before state is cleared.
buyPiece increments the buyer balance and decrements the seller balance.
Local _amountOwner is transferred to the owner.
Local _amountEthart is transferred to the registrar.
Local _amountSeller is transferred to the seller.
_amountOwner is produced by the division-based commission arithmetic.
_amountEthart is produced by msg.value / 40.
_amountSeller = msg.value - _amountOwner - _amountEthart.
offerPieceForSale records msg.sender as lowestAskAddress.
ethArtOnlyAfterOneYear modifier gates the offer using now > activationTime + 31536000.
offerPieceForSale requires _price < lowestAskPrice and updates it.
offerPieceForSale writes lowestAskAddress.
offerPieceForSale sets lowestAskTime = now.
offerPieceForSale sets pieceForSale = true.
offerPieceForSale compares _price with highestBidPrice.
offerPieceForSale calls fillBid when _price <= highestBidPrice.
_price parameter is the ask price.
placeBid records msg.sender as highestBidAddress and forwards value.
placeBid reads and updates highestBidPrice.
placeBid writes/clears highestBidAddress.
placeBid refunds the previous highest bidder before overwriting bid state.
The refund transfer to the previous bidder can re-enter placeBid before highestBidPrice is overwritten.
placeBid forwards to buyPiece when the bid covers the lowest ask.
placeBid sets highestBidTime = now.
placeBid writes highestBidTime.
ownerFirst modifier compares msg.sender with owner and checks piecesOwned[owner].
ownerFirst and ethArtOnlyAfterOneYear gates depend on now and highestBidTime.
fillBid transfers ETH to owner, seller and registrar before clearing pieceWanted and decrementing balances.
ETH recipients in fillBid can re-enter before piecesOwned and pieceWanted are updated.
fillBid computes commission as highestBidPrice / 10000 * ownerCommission with rounding loss.
fillBid calls registrar.issuePatrons after ETH transfers.
registrar.issuePatrons external call can re-enter fillBid before state is cleared.
fillBid increments the bidder balance and decrements the seller balance.
fillBid sends the owner commission to the privileged owner address.
Local _amountOwner is transferred to the owner.
Local _amountEthart is transferred to the registrar.
Local _amountSeller is transferred to msg.sender.
Local patronReward is passed to issuePatrons.
fillBid clears pieceWanted.
fillBid reads and resets highestBidPrice.
fillBid reads and clears highestBidAddress.
onlyBy(highestBidAddress) modifier compares msg.sender against the stored bidder.
cancelBid requires now > highestBidTime + 86400 before refunding.
cancelBid transfers highestBidPrice to msg.sender before fully clearing bid state.
The refund transfer in cancelBid can re-enter before highestBidPrice is zeroed.
cancelBid clears pieceWanted.
cancelBid zeroes highestBidPrice.
cancelBid clears highestBidAddress.
onlyBy(lowestAskAddress) modifier compares msg.sender against the stored seller.
cancelSale requires now > lowestAskTime + 86400.
cancelSale clears pieceForSale.
cancelSale zeroes lowestAskPrice.
cancelSale clears lowestAskAddress.
